message.content:
The vertical editorial illustration features a blue background populated by stylized, diverse people. At the top, white text reads "LAPORAN KHUSUS" and "INOVASI PENDIDIKAN MELAWAN CORONA." Below this, large yellow letters spell "TEMPO."

In the center, large white block letters state "KUSUT BANTUAN SOSIAL," followed by smaller white text: "PROGRAM JARING PENGAMAN SOSIAL UNTUK MEREDAM DAMPAK COVID-19 ACAK-ACAKAN. TUMPANG-TINDIH DAN SALAH SASARAN AKIBAT DATA AMBURADUL."

Dozens of people of various sizes, skin tones, and attire surround the central text. Some wear masks, others wear sunglasses or face coverings. Characters include individuals in professional suits, religious garments, casual streetwear, and traditional Indonesian clothing like sarongs and peci hats. At the top left, two men in black suits and sunglasses stand side-by-side. On the right, a person wears a bright green jacket with a white Wi-Fi symbol. At the bottom, several figures are shown from the back or side, including a man in a black patterned shirt and another with a grey backpack. A QR code and barcode with numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00011" are at the bottom corners. Small text indicates "4-10 MEI 2020" and "RP 45.000."
